This '''female Sith Saber''' was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] who lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], she served as a member of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Viun Gaalan]]'s strike team sent to retrieve the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. After [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|capturing]] several [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], the [[Sith Saber|Saber]] stayed behind, along with Gaalan, [[Viun Gaalan's aide|Gaalan's aide]], and a [[Unidentified male Sith Saber (Viun Gaalan)|male Sith Saber]] to wait for Khai to retrieve [[Halliava Vurse|one last Nightsister]]. However, before Khai returned, the Sith were [[Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow|attacked]] by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his son, [[Ben Skywalker]], and the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dyon Stadd]]. The [[Gender/Legends|male]] Saber was quickly [[Death/Legends|killed]] as Gaalan engaged the elder Skywalker in a [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]]. Meanwhile, the female Sith Saber attacked Stadd, who proved very difficult to kill, using acrobatic maneuvers to stay out of her reach. After helping Ben Skywalker kill Gaalan's aide, the two then attacked the Sith Saber. Stadd fired on her with his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and she deflected the shot at Ben Skywalker, who deflected it back at her. The bolt hit her weapon hand, and as she staggered back, Stadd shot her in the gut and Skywalker [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] her.
